Chinese Manchow Soup
By: Rahul Upadhyay
Published: Tuesday, January 16, 2018 - 3:44am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Manchow Soup
4 Cups (800ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Mix pack content with 4 cups (800ml) of water till there are no loops. 3 Step 2: 4 Bring to boil. Stirring continously. Simmer for 3 minutes. 5 Serve Hot!!

About

Make the delicious and mouthwatering soup in just a few minutes. Manchow soup its and tasty healthy Desi Chinese Manchow Soup Recipe. It’s easy and quick recipe to make at home served with love to your loved ones.
